Is this Phu Quoc or Italy 😉
Jun 2026 • Couples
This is a place I visited twice while traveling in Phu Quoc. Usually, when I travel, I don't go to a restaurant I've been to before, but I went back here because the wood-fired pizza and pasta were so delicious haha.

The wood-fired pizza was really delicious. Among the pizzas I've had in Phu Quoc, this one is my personal favorite! The dough is delicious and the overall food quality is good, so if you like pizza, you might want to check it out.

The pasta was delicious, and it was also good that there were various desserts, so I could take care of both the meal and dessert at once. I especially recommend trying the tiramisu. I actually felt more satisfied after eating dessert haha

And it looked good for going with kids too. They sell dishes like fried rice and tteokbokki, so it will be easy to choose a menu even if I go with kids who don't like Vietnamese food.

If you're looking for a pizza restaurant in Phu Quoc, I personally liked this one the best. It's a place I have a reason to visit twice :)
